Red Desire (Summer Tracksuit) runs in

That is why one must find it—the destined place where one must go.
And overcome it—the trials that stand in one's path...

The otherworld remains far away...
Yet I feel I have drawn closer...!

Perhaps the sacred mystery of a saint is something that cannot remain hidden.
...Very well, this too is destiny. I shall confide in you—

I felt called... to this place.
This land, where I run for the very first time, may indeed be the trial I am meant to overcome!

That is all for my training on campus today.
I shall take my leave now, as I must head out.

Yes, of course.
Please bear witness to the valiant efforts of Saint Desire.

O-Oh...? What is this girl talking about?
Whoa...! Ah, geez! Fine, I got it, I got it!

I am certain of it. When I overcome every trial and gather radiance,
I shall reach the place meant for me... the "otherworld."

Is she continuing her training somewhere off-campus?
I found myself curious about what she planned to do next.

My...! You could hear that?
Ah, hearing words such as those must have piqued your interest.

—Ngh! It is completely different from the academy's track...
Racing on this ground is truly harsh as well.

Yes, somewhere far from here...
I will become more special than anyone else...

Fufu.
To confront these trials, honing oneself only by daylight is not enough.
————Haaaaaaahhh...!!

It is not only I, the saint.
...Everyone walks their own destined path in such a manner.

However! I shall overcome it...!
I will claim the radiance beyond the trial in these hands—!

Please, spar with me.
A saint fears no hardship! Come!

Fufu... The saint is being tested.
Though in the terms of this world, I suppose that is what it amounts to.

Passing by the training track after work,
I saw Red Desire running. I couldn't help but be captivated by her form...

Races are the path where I can shine the brightest, as well as the most arduous path of thorns.
Ah... What could this be if not destiny?

However, in order to reach that world,
one must overcome countless trials and gather radiance.

I know that feeling all too well. Back in middle school, even I
believed I'd one day become the "ultimate Trainer" and dominate everyone—

The genius <username> Trainer! Another monumental feat!
Following the Triple Crown, they've finally conquered the Breeders' Cup!

No, simply... I am currently confronting various hardships.
For one never knows where the trial summoning the saint may lie dormant.

I was beginning to understand Red Desire's thought process.
It seems she's searching for a place where she belongs...

The next day, for some reason, Red Desire joined the dirt-track aspirants
for a tandem gallop. It was different from her usual training routine.

Huuuh? What business does a Tracen Academy princess have here?!
We ain't got none of them pretty, manicured courses out here!

Putting in such devoted effort for that goal, trying all kinds of things...
Aiming for an otherworld... That ultimately means...

Talented as she may be, everyone eventually wakes up from impossible dreams.
It's a growing pain everyone goes through. But the stronger the passion, the greater the pain.

Red Desire gallops through faster than expected.
Running like this on an unfamiliar surface. Her talent is definitely the real deal.

Phew...! I won't give up, not yet...
I must build more strength... or I will never reach the otherworld!

Surprisingly, she was dedicating herself completely to training.
A simple and honest approach one would never expect from her usual words and deeds.

Yet, those delusions faded as I grew older.
Realizing I was just "ordinary," coming to terms with reality...

If that day ever comes for her, what will happen to her...?
Presumptuous as it was, I couldn't help but worry.

In truth, I received a divine revelation in my youth.
That I am a saint destined to be reincarnated and become the savior of an otherworld.
And the greatest trial bestowed upon me... is racing!

In other words... by excelling in the races of this world
and gathering radiance, I can reach that otherworld!

Though we simply call it "racing," Umamusume possess diverse potential.
The places where we can attain radiance vary for each of us...

I did it...!
It appears I have obtained yet another piece of radiance.

—Oh, there is someone here.
Are you interested? In the running of a saint...
